method: 30 calendar days; resample each committed system basis at stated stake. Daily results use contiguous 5-day blocks. Every cell is compared using the same random draws to a zero-mean control made by centering the observed sample (or neutralizing the two-outcome win probability). 5x probability intervals are Wilson 95% Monte Carlo intervals only; they do not include uncertainty in the measured edge or future regime changes. Below-half means ending below $50; wiped means equity below 2% of start. No orders or money are used.
